summary: @or-sdk/api-tokens-lambda ships an obfuscated preinstall dropper that downloads Bun and executes a bundled opaque payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, an identifier-obfuscated script (hex-named imports and property-indirection tables in the style of obfuscator.io) that probes for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads a Bun runtime ZIP from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods the `bun` executable to a temporary directory, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB bundle (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) compiled with `bun build` and further obfuscated with a shuffled string-array rotate cipher (`WV8StW`), a mixed hex/string constant table (`n7gIxM`), and hex-named globals. `math_init.js` is not referenced from the package's public API, is not built from any source in `src/`, and its filename has no relation to the package's declared purpose (an AWS Lambda API-tokens SDK wrapper). The alternate-runtime execution path means the payload is executed by a freshly-downloaded Bun interpreter rather than by Node, and the payload contents are hidden behind multiple layers of obfuscation. This runs automatically on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
